pages.quiz:
PHYSICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: PHYSICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. A chemical reaction forming ash
   C. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   D. Heating until a solid melts

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Floating and Sinking? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Floating and Sinking.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Floating and Sinking.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Floating and Sinking.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Floating and Sinking.

3. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. Any substance that conducts electricity
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Only carbon dioxide
   B. Only water vapour
   C. Glucose and oxygen
   D. Nitrogen gas only

5. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. A mixture always has a fixed melting point

6. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 100 °C

7. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Milk souring
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Paper burning to ash
   D. Ice melting to water

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Quantity of Heat? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Quantity of Heat.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Quantity of Heat.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Quantity of Heat.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Quantity of Heat.

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Mains electricity? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Mains electricity.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Mains electricity.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Mains electricity.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Mains electricity.

10. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Circular motion? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Circular motion.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Circular motion.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Circular motion.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Transistors? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Transistors.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Transistors.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Transistors.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Photoelectric effect? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Photoelectric effect.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Photoelectric effect.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Photoelectric effect.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Thin lenses and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Photoelectric effect and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Electromagnetic induction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Mains electricity and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. C — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

3. C — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

6. D — 100 °C

7. D — Ice melting to water

10. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Circular motion.

11. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Transistors.

12. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Photoelectric effect.
